mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_reservation (warehouse_id, sku_id, source_document_type, source_document_id, source_document_item_id, quantity, unit_snapshot, status, occurred_at, operator, version, deleted, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{warehouseId}, #{skuId}, #{sourceDocumentType}, #{sourceDocumentId}, #{sourceDocumentItemId}, #{quantity}, #{unitSnapshot}, #{status}, #{occurredAt}, #{operator}, 0, FALSE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (source_document_type, source_document_item_id) WHERE deleted = FALSE AND source_document_item_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM inventory_reservation WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE

SELECT * FROM inventory_reservation WHERE source_document_type = #{sourceDocumentType} AND source_document_id = #{sourceDocumentId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted = FALSE -- 释放要按 (warehouse_id, sku_id) 升序拿余额锁，这里先排好，调用方不必再排一次 ORDER BY warehouse_id ASC, sku_id ASC
SELECT * FROM inventory_reservation WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_reservation SET status = 'RELEASED', version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE inventory_reservation SET status = 'CONSUMED', version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'ACTIVE'
